catchbook_deliverable: Professional repo hygiene for CatchBook with Conventional Commits and PR template
description: Master professional commit message conventions and pull request templates. Learn to write clear, consistent commit messages following the Conventional Commits specification. Create PR templates that streamline code review and maintain high-quality documentation. Establish the repository hygiene patterns that will support CatchBook's evolution across all 28 phases.
learning_objectives: Understand the value of consistent commit message format for project history
Write commit messages following Conventional Commits specification
Structure commit messages with type, scope, subject, body, and footer
Use semantic commit types (feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, chore)
Create GitHub PR templates with consistent structure
Write clear PR descriptions that facilitate code review
Link commits and PRs to issues using GitHub syntax
Apply commit conventions to all CatchBook development work

catchbook_integration.feature_area: Repository documentation and commit hygiene infrastructure
